title: After the warmest weather of the year so far, is winter finally over?
description: As we start meteorological spring, Simon King explores whether it is time to put away your winter coat.
content:
For meteorologists, spring is the three months of March, April and May. This means we have fixed periods of time to make comparisons and record what has happened during the season.
